messages:
sre-jen: noticing a spike of apiserver 5xxs in ap-south1 starting ~02:12 UTC right after the GPU pool scale. controller-manager restarts and leader election churn. anyone seeing this?
infra-li: seeing the same. etcd leader RTT jumped, raft re-syncs kicked in. looks like NVMe I/O saturation on controlplane nodes around the attach window.
ml-ryan: we kicked a fast attach for ~200 GPU nodes (rolling). attached images use snapshot=true to speed boot — could be stomping storage.
devops-noah: checking metrics now — apiserver latency up, watch reconnects rising. controller queues for gpu-claims spiked ~20x.
sre-jen: @oncall-bot openinc Incident: ap-south1 controlplane degradation (apiserver+etcd+controller-manager)
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-20260321-2301 by sre-jen. PagerDuty notified.
infra-li: pulling node-level metrics: nvme qdepth ~95% on cp-nvme0 and cp-nvme1, IOPS spike aligns with attach timeline.
ml-ryan: fast attach probably triggered snapshot restore I/O on the same controlplane-backed storage. our attach concurrency was set to 50.
devops-noah: can we throttle the attach rate? provisioner has an attach_rate knob per-region.
sre-jen: mitigation in-flight: paused remaining attach jobs, dropped attach concurrency to 10, and reverted controller-manager leader election skew to default.
infra-li: etcd quorum stayed intact but raft commit latency jumped to 300-400ms, apiserver returned some writes as 503. KV write retries visible in controller logs.
devops-noah: logs:
```
E0321 02:12:34 apiserver.go:123] 503 etcdserver: request timed out
W0321 02:12:35 controller.go:89] controller-manager: failed to sync: failed to update status: etcdserver: request timed out
```
ml-ryan: agree stability > ramp. slowing attach reduces TTA for some jobs but prevents downstream controlplane grief.
sre-jen: hypothesis: control-plane NVMe/storage IO saturation from aggressive GPU attach snapshot restores + kubelet attach churn + peering egress bandwidth constraints caused elevated etcd latency -> apiserver 5xxs and controller thrash.
infra-li: long-term fixes: 1) rate-limit attach per-region; 2) pre-warm local images in ap-south1 to avoid snapshot restores; 3) add raft_commit_lat_p95 alert >200ms.
devops-noah: filed INFRA-2026-342 to add attach_rate limiter + per-region autoscale throttling and followup runbook.
sre-jen: followups: keep attach concurrency <=10 for now; backfill warm images; add p95 commit latency alert; postmortem if incident >30m.
oncall-bot: Incident INC-20260321-2301 status: mitigated. Duration: ~18m.
devops-noah: quick cost note: warm images increase storage cost marginally (~+0.8%) but cut snapshot I/O significantly.
ml-ryan: ack, will update the GPU onboarding playbook and include attach-rate guidance.
